description: Customizable Windows Dynamic Island with media controls, 30+ widgets, weather, system monitoring, quick toggles, and local component plugins.
notes: Uses the official Windows x64 single-file portable release. The release build enables single-file publish and includes the .NET 8 runtime; no setup installer or separate desktop runtime is required.
Settings and application data are stored under %APPDATA%\WinIslands, outside the Scoop app directory.
